name: 035_multiday_momentum_tf5_time
hypothesis: A five to twenty day high or low is where trend-following funds add risk, because their mandate is to hold the extreme rather than to forecast it. That is a structural reason for the move to continue rather than reverse: the buyers of a new high are institutions with a rule that says buy, not people with a view. The reason to test it both-sided with no directional filter is that this effect should not care about the sign of the market - it continued down through 2022 and up through 2023-24, and a rule that only works in the bull market is the drift this project has spent four rounds trying to separate from an edge. The kill condition is deliberately two-sided: it dies if TRAIN gross_r <= 0, and it also dies if the whole result is one side in the period where that side matches the drift. [Timeframe variant of 035_multiday_momentum, 240m -> 5m, mode time: bar counts x48, ATR multiples x6.928, same hours and % stops.]
